separate_verified_connectors.name: GitHub connector
separate_verified_connectors.capabilities: Repository reads, PR inspection, branch creation, branch-only commits, PR creation and CI/Actions evidence retrieval.
separate_verified_connectors.permissions_used_this_run: Read repository/PR/workflow evidence; created and updated dedicated branches and draft PR #1390; no main write or merge.
separate_verified_connectors.constraints: No GitHub secret values accessed; no merge, force-push or deployment.

structured_handoff_schema.rule: A platform response is not an evidence source until its claims resolve to traceable source URLs or reproducible artifacts. A platform handoff is not verified until artifact checksum, schema and task acceptance checks pass.

task_independence_and_disagreement.parallelize: Assign independent source discovery and hypothesis testing; do not show one agent another agent's conclusion before its first independent submission when feasible.
task_independence_and_disagreement.adjudication: Compare primary-source strength, source independence, timestamp alignment, measurement definitions, reproducibility and disconfirming evidence; do not resolve by majority vote.
task_independence_and_disagreement.minority_objections: Retain unresolved dissent with author/platform, claim, evidence, assumptions and test that could resolve it.
task_independence_and_disagreement.red_team: A separate reviewer challenges source identity, causal direction, look-ahead leakage, alternative explanations and model overfit.

least_privilege_and_fallbacks.default_permissions: Public read-only; no credential sharing between platforms.
least_privilege_and_fallbacks.credentials: Use platform-native scoped credentials only after explicit authentication; never put secrets in prompts, repository files or shared evidence bundles.
least_privilege_and_fallbacks.writes: Branch-only code writes after task authorization; no main writes, merges, force-pushes, deployments or real-money actions.
least_privilege_and_fallbacks.data_minimization: Share only sanitized public research evidence and necessary code; no private personal data.
least_privilege_and_fallbacks.fallback: If an API is unavailable/rate-limited, use cached timestamped public snapshots or local deterministic analysis and mark the task BLOCKED/DEFERRED rather than fabricating a handoff.

acceptance_gates: Authentication and permission scope tested separately for each platform.
A minimal read-only probe succeeds and records exact endpoint/workspace and timestamp.
A structured evidence handoff validates against the schema.
Source provenance and independence groups are checked.
A reviewer reproduces at least one result.
Write capability remains disabled until a separate approval and branch-only test.
current_result: Only the ChatGPT session and the separate GitHub connector are verified active. The other eight target platforms are design targets, not live collaborators. No external credentials were requested or used.
